title: Cucumber Salad
instructions: Mix the cucumbers and salt. Cover with a plate that rests on the cucumbers and weigh it down with a 1lb can. Let it stand for 1-2 hours. Drain.
Mix the lemon juice, oil, and sugar. Add to the cucumbers with the dill and onion. Mix and refrigerate.

tips.title: Weigh them down
tips.text: The plate and 1lb can press the water out of the salted cucumbers, so the salad stays crisp instead of watery.

notes: From the wedding cookbook, signed '- Kayla'. The salted cucumbers stand for 1-2 hours before the dressing goes on — that resting time is passive, not counted in the prep time. The photo on the submitted page is a family snapshot, not the dish, so the banner photo is a web photo of cucumber dill salad.
